options.label: Bike taxi

costEstimate.basis: Typical app bike-taxi pricing in Kochi, approximate; surge not included

instructions: Take a bike taxi (17.6 km) to Vyttila Hub. Book in a ride-hailing app; pickup wait is assumed.

assumptions: Road times assume typical city speeds (bike taxi ~22 km/h, taxi ~20 km/h); no live traffic data.
Bike taxi fare is an approximate range, not a quote.

options.label: Bus

costEstimate.basis: Kerala ordinary bus fare structure (minimum fare + per-km), approximate

instructions: Board the bus towards Chottanikkara at Karothukuzhi.
Ride 27 stops and get off at Vyttila.
Departure time is an estimate (assumed 10-min average wait).

assumptions: Bus feed headways are a uniform 60-minute placeholder; an assumed 20-minute headway (10-minute expected wait) is used instead.
Bus fare is an approximate range, not a quote.
warnings: Bus routes come from 2022–23 community data and may have changed.

options.label: Metro

costEstimate.basis: KMRL fare table (single-journey token; card/QR discounts not applied)

instructions: Board the metro towards Tripunithura at Aluva.

assumptions: Metro times follow the KMRL timetable (feed expired 2025-12-31; assumed unchanged).
